python3 - <<'PY'
p='tests/codegen/eval.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old = "/// Verifies eval `sscanf()` returns indexed string matches through direct and callable paths."
new = ("/// Verifies eval `sscanf()` returns php-typed matches through direct and callable paths.\n"
       "///\n"
       "/// `-2.5e3` reads back as `-2500`, not as the matched text: `%f` yields a FLOAT, so echoing\n"
       "/// it prints php's float rendering. The old assertion held the scanned SLICE, which is what\n"
       "/// the interpreter's scanf subset used to answer — `php -n` (8.5.6) gives `float(-2500)`.")
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
old2 = '    assert_eq!(out, "John:1.5:30:-25:-2.5e3:ok:1");'
new2 = '    assert_eq!(out, "John:1.5:30:-25:-2500:ok:1");'
assert s.count(old2)==1
s=s.replace(old2,new2)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('patched eval codegen test')
